paper.title_en: The seeds and silhouettes of optimal gravitational shielding
paper.abstract_en: We construct complete vacuum initial data sets with prescribed asymptotically flat exterior geometry, including the gluing of two Schwarzschild exterior regions with small masses (which need not be positive). The construction allows for arbitrarily slow leading decay and nonzero second fundamental form. For leading terms with a fixed radial power, we first construct localized seed data sets whose constraint errors decay to any prescribed finite order, then apply the projection and stability theorems of our companion papers. The resulting vacuum data sets differ from seeds by harmonic terms controlled by Hamiltonian and momentum silhouettes, and by super-harmonic corrections. This difference of harmonic terms is measured by a relative notion of ADM energy-momentum, which is defined even for slowly-decaying data sets that do not admit an ADM energy-momentum. Upon adjusting seed data sets by either harmonic-decaying terms or compact transverse-traceless terms, we freely control this relative ADM charge and, when it exists, the total ADM charge. In particular, when gluing Schwarzschild metrics the total ADM mass can be specified independently of the Schwarzschild mass parameters. Together with our companion papers, these results establish a constructive theory of optimal localization beyond harmonic decay.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究带规定渐近平坦外部几何的真空初始数据集构造，涉及Schwarzschild外部区域粘合、ADM能量-动量及哈密顿/动量轮廓控制，理论深度较高，方法体系完整（种子数据+投影与稳定性定理），属于广义相对论基础中初始数据问题的严肃工作，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 最优引力屏蔽的种子与轮廓
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了具有规定渐近平坦外部几何的完整真空初始数据集，包括将两个具有小质量（质量不必为正）的Schwarzschild外部区域进行粘合。该构造允许任意慢的主衰减以及非零的第二基本形式。对于具有固定径向幂次的主项，我们首先构造局部化的种子数据集，其约束误差可衰减到任意规定的有限阶，然后应用我们姊妹论文中的投影与稳定性定理。所得的真空数据集与种子数据相差由哈密顿轮廓和动量轮廓控制的调和项，以及超调和修正项。这种调和项之差由一种相对意义的ADM能量-动量来度量，该量即使对于不承认ADM能量-动量的慢衰减数据集也有定义。通过用调和衰减项或紧致横向无迹项调整种子数据集，我们可以自由控制这一相对ADM荷，并在其存在时控制总ADM荷。特别地，在粘合Schwarzschild度规时，总ADM质量可以独立于Schwarzschild质量参数而被指定。结合我们的姊妹论文，这些结果建立了一套超越调和衰减的最优局域化的构造性理论。
